notes.title: Meet the writer. Still SFW.
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248106/b84e329399800eba16b6f0422cc25b49e654ee89.png"][/img][i]Tangerine Antarctic – a player-first true detective RPG with a branching story, where your choices are everything.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Our community manager asked one of the writers for a devblog post. This is the completely honest and accurate report he got in reply.[/b][/p][p]
I’m not forwarding any fucking memes. The buck stops here. [/p][p]I open the calendar, see a meeting that has fuck-all to do with me, and start pestering someone on WhatsApp to send me the link. Which they do, with a vaguely upbeat hesitance. [/p][p]The sliding camera cover on my laptop is half open, exposing a quarter of my greasy hair. I close it for a second but then uncover it again. [/p][p]“Nice of you to join us,” says someone. “We were just discussing…” and they go on explaining whatever the fuck they were discussing. I nod approvingly, bless the meeting with a cross gesture like a priest, and leave. [/p][p]Caffeine. I cook a cup of double espresso with my moka pot, using Red Bull instead of water. Great stuff, gets me pumped up for my shift. I log on to Jira and proceed to move random tickets from Not Started to In Progress to In Review to Finished. This is how work gets done, bitches, 34 hours worth of tickets solved in one minute. [/p][p]All the apps are blinking with memes, 317 in total. Not forwarding any of them. Not a single fucking one. I am the motherfucking last stand — the Three Gorges Dam. In this life you can be an asshole or a simp, and good guys finish last. Moving the tickets is the easiest hustle ever, so yeah, no empathy for losers moaning about crunch time. [/p][p]I finish a few more tickets. It’s almost half past noon, so I should get dressed if I want to retain my morning-person credentials. I consider intellectual honesty to be very important.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248106/3b320fa5fbc5a89c78925b9542b941a02316a580.jpg"][/img][i]And here’s a photo from the Dark Math writers room.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Wanna know more, detective? Mainline the making of Tangerine Antarctic in real time on our Discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/e4EZbnBcbE"]https://discord.gg/e4EZbnBcbE[/url][/p]

notes.title: How did you sleep, detective?
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248106/078785b9955f5f4f0fe4c9b7a9778d6fe3749943.png"][/img][/p][p]Your next favorite true detective RPG has a name: [b]Tangerine Antarctic[/b]. And you’ll play it in full 3rd person perspective. All to make Tangerine Antarctic a player-first, deep, and unique role-playing experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Our Art Director, Timo Albert, said it best: [i]“Tangerine Antarctic is the name of the hotel you wake up in. Trapped there by a blizzard, you’ll dig through walls of snow and silence to solve a string of murders. And Tangerine Antarctic isn’t just a place. It’s one of the key characters in this true detective’s RPG.”[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248106/24bb121dd87c2e241c007a4b91051f113075d68b.png"][/img][/p][p]Architectural concept art of Tangerine Antarctic, exterior view[/p][p][/p][p]The Tangerine Antarctic hotel is designed by renowned architect Kaur Stöör, who brings his expertise in mountain architecture to Antarctica. We’ll show more of it soon. The place is mad even by the standards of 2086. It’s a refuge for the powerful, the secretive, and the plain strange. You should not be there. But what can you do? Murders don’t solve themselves. It takes a detective or two![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248106/671144ae84ca2e3002f8efdf4f4f360e24fad075.png"][/img][/p][p]Architectural concept art of Tangerine Antarctic, lobby[/p][p][/p][p]You can bring your own unique detecting style to Tangerine Antarctic soon. Stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, check out the Enguri Attractions in the Caucasus Mountains, Georgia; a project Stöör worked on with his colleagues at KOKO Architects: [/p][p][url="https://arhliit.ee/en/project/enguri-attractions/"]https://arhliit.ee/en/project/enguri-attractions/[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Or dive into the rest of his impressive portfolio: [/p][p][url="https://arhliit.ee/en/author/lembit-kaur-stoor/"]https://arhliit.ee/en/author/lembit-kaur-stoor/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]And pre-orders are now open on Xsolla. Be the first on the crime scene. Order now.[/p][p][url="https://tangerine-antarctic.xsolla.site/"]https://tangerine-antarctic.xsolla.site/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Would-be Disco Elysium successor XXX Nightshift morphs from an isometric RPG into a third-person ski resort murder mystery
notes.notes:
Dark Math Games, one of the multiple studios staffed by former Disco Elysium developers to pop up and announce a very Disco Elysiumy RPG last year, have given their game a revamp. XXX Nightshift is now called Tangerine Antarctic, with the switch also bringing a shift from isometric perspective to third-person.

If you missed the recent flourishing of Disco spiritual successors created by ex-ZA/UMers, the others include Longdue's RPG Hopetown and Summer Eternal's mystery project. Meanwhile, Disco writer Robert Kurvitz and artist Aleksander Rostov are making something for a studio called Red Info, and ZA/UM themselves are working on a new CRPG called Zero Parades. It's all very easy to keep track of.

notes.title: DevBlog #4
notes.notes:
XXX NIGHTSHIFT is a player-first true detective RPG. You can role-play as one of the two smartest people in the world. Why are you so bright? 

Freeman Dyson: “That’s not how the question phrases itself. The question is: why is everyone else so stupid?”

Soon we’ll introduce you to a fresh and powerful role-playing system consisting of 20 Traces divided into four Attributes: Time, Space, Matter and Quantum. You’ll use these Traces to form and inform you. Levelling them up unlocks infinite ways to role-play the hero you're truly destined to be.

Today is all about you: Dinorah Katz.

notes.title: Dev Blog #1
notes.notes:
So here’s the news. The XXX NIGHTSHIFT Alpha build announcement date is approaching and we need you people to help us test drive the RPG systems. If you sign up through a pre-order, you’ll get some perks as a bonus. Like an instant download of the Xenia Titanin Digital Comic. Check out the trailer here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jt73qSOHxjo 
 
The Revolution that is depicted in the digital comic happens 35 years before the events of the game at World’s End, Mount Hope, Antarctica (2086). Pre-order and enlist as a tester here: 
https://xxx-nightshift.xsolla.site/


We have more news. John Cunningham, who executive produced the most streamed hiphop album of all time, XXXTentacion’s “?”, is now in charge of our music and sound. Not just OST, but weaving sound into gameplay giving you freedom to express yourself more than has ever been possible in role playing games. As John stated his mission: “And most importantly how can I impart the feeling upon the player that we are all artists in our own right?” 

The original soundtrack will land in your mailbox for free when we drop the game if you choose the Deep Insider option. Again, see all of the cool stuff at: https://xxx-nightshift.xsolla.site/ 

Thanks everyone! Oh yeah, the music and sound of both of our trailers were John’s. 
Nightshift over and out.

notes.title: One of those potential Disco Elysium spiritual successors says it's secured a bunch of investment Kapital to help it make its Marx
notes.notes:
Dark Math Games - a splinter studio with ex-ZA/UM devs currently working on its own detective RPG XXX Nightshift - just secured new funding. This cash injection comes courtesy of MM Grupp, an Estonian investment company which had previously helped fund Disco Elysium itself.

notes.title: There's a playable Disco Elysium 2 prototype in the wilds, according to a report on clashes between the "spiritual successors"
notes.notes:
On 11th October 2024, three video game studios announced themselves near-simultaneously as the creators of “spiritual successors” to ZA/UM’s mournful Marxist RPG Disco Elysium. First came Longdue, a conspicuously corporate operator who are making an untitled “psychogeographic RPG”. Dark Math Games followed around lunchtime - they’re making a sexy Antarctic ski resort mystery called XXX Nightshift. Finally, there was Summer Eternal, the mouthiest and Marxiest of the lot, who have set themselves up as a workers co-operative and have yet to announce a specific project.

Read more

notes.title: Disco Elysium's potential 'spiritual successors' reportedly come with even more behind-the-scenes drama, including a bizarre spat about photos of someone's ex-wife
notes.notes:
It feels like almost ever since Disco Elysium arrived in our lives, it's been linked to behind-the-scenes messiness which, while it's taken various forms and involved different parties, usually follows some similar themes. It's generally quite complex - as they said/this other person said video game drama often is - sometimes litigious, and occasionally really weird, if still clearly worth taking seriously.

notes.title: XXX Nightshift is a new sci-fi detective RPG from Dark Math Games - another new studio founded by former Disco Elysium developers
notes.notes:
A group of former members of the original development team of RPG darling Disco Elysium have today revealed their first new title under a new UK studio: XXX Nightshift. No, you’re not getting deja vu - this really has happened twice in one day, with this reveal following hot on the heels of the announcement of Longdue, another indie studio from former Disco staffers.
